decision: Defer both candidates; no production changes.

fixture.reuse: Existing exclusive private fixture; no live or archived 2M query.

variants.baseline: Native AEAD + bounded decoder hint + synchronous existing-page cache hits + dense sorted phrase positions.
variants.map: Exact base lexical value keyed by (TF,document length), bounded to one term in one 1024-document posting; field boost added after lookup.
variants.last: One-entry consecutive (TF,length) memo using three scalar locals; boost added after lookup.

method.queries: Broad single words, phrases, names, fuzzy and prefix/suffix edges, repeated words; unfiltered and group:email.
method.cpu: /proc/self/stat aggregate query deltas; 100 ticks per second.

correctness.candidateComparisonClarification: Each candidate has 120 exact ordered-ID checks against baseline-established goldens; 360 includes 120 baseline checks.
correctness.canonicalCases: Mixed field boosts, alternating TF/length pairs, multiple terms/IDFs and pages, vector on/off, long repeated phrases, editorial relevance and posting validation.

memory.attribution: Three workers open in one process; RSS cannot establish separate candidate peak-memory benefit.

limits: 100k CPU experiment, not a 2M latency gate.
Both candidates miss the required 5% aggregate CPU improvement; some individual queries regress.
No further runs or promotion justified.
